build_vlm_pipeline: build a VlmPipeline instance with VlmConvertOptions to convert PDF documents using vision-language models
create_default_pipeline_options: create default VlmPipelineOptions by calling VlmPipeline.get_default_options() for VLM document conversion
test_backend_supported: test whether a backend is supported by VlmPipeline using is_backend_supported() for PDF documents
run_assemble_document: run _assemble_document to convert VLM predictions into a DoclingDocument from doctags or markdown
summarize_parse_deepseekocr: summarize _parse_deepseekocr_markdown to parse DeepSeek OCR markdown output with bounding box labels into a document
